mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (name, email, age, sex, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{age}, #{sex}, FALSE, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, email, age, sex, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM students WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT id, name, email, age, sex, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM students WHERE deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, age = #{age}, sex = #{sex}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE students SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
